body.message:
I understand; however, we are unable to confirm the rate at AED 20,000 per month.

Once you confirm the agreed rate, we will proceed with the online check-in process. We will then share the payment link for the security deposit to secure and block the unit under your name, along with the tenancy contract for your online signature.

If you prefer to make the rent payment by cash, our team can arrange to collect it on the check-in date.
